questions.q: What was the title and date of Bitcoin's whitepaper?
options: "The Bit Gold Protocol," published in 1998
"Digital Currency for the Future," published in 2015
"Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System," published October 31, 2008
It was never actually published as a written document
questions.explain: Satoshi Nakamoto's nine-page whitepaper, published on that exact date, laid out Bitcoin's real, working design.

questions.q: What was genuinely new about Bitcoin's whitepaper, given that proof-of-work already existed (via Hashcash)?
options: Applying proof-of-work to solve the double-spending problem in a fully decentralized currency
Nothing was actually new — it was a complete copy of Hashcash
Creating the first ever encrypted email
Inventing the concept of a computer for the first time
questions.explain: The novelty wasn't proof-of-work itself, but adapting it specifically to make decentralized consensus — and therefore double-spend prevention — actually work at scale.

questions.q: What is embedded in the Coinbase transaction of Bitcoin's genesis block?
options: Satoshi Nakamoto's real legal name
The complete source code for Ethereum
A 50 bitcoin reward, plus a real newspaper headline about a bank bailout
Nothing — the genesis block is empty
questions.explain: Block zero's Coinbase transaction includes a 50 BTC reward and a Times headline ("Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks") interpreted as both a timestamp and commentary on banking instability.

questions.q: Which real clue has fueled speculation about Satoshi Nakamoto's identity?
options: A verified video interview with Nakamoto
Nakamoto's published tax records
Forum-posting timestamps showing almost no activity during Japan's daytime hours
A DNA sample submitted to a public database
questions.explain: A graphed analysis of Nakamoto's forum post timestamps showed an unusual sleep-like gap inconsistent with living in Japan, feeding ongoing speculation about the true identity.

questions.q: Has Satoshi Nakamoto's true identity ever been definitively confirmed?
options: Yes, it was confirmed by the U.S. government in 2015
No — it remains genuinely unresolved to this day
Yes, it was proven to be a large corporation
Yes, Nakamoto publicly revealed themselves in 2020
questions.explain: Despite extensive analysis of writing style, timing patterns, and code quality, nobody has definitively proven who Nakamoto actually is.
